title: LaunchRequest
description: Start a session on an issue. Only the caller's own companions are eligible (ADR 0004).

branch.description:
The branch to launch on, `issue/<n>-<slug>`: one of the caller's drafts of the issue
when they own several (ADR 0053); otherwise the only one, or a slug.

companion_id.description: One of the caller's companions; the only connected one when omitted.

role.description: `lead` starts a person's lead agent, only while the orchestrator flag is on (ADR 0072).

slug.description: Branch slug; derived from the issue title when omitted.

LaunchRole.description: What a launch is for: an ordinary worker, or a person's lead agent (ADR 0072).
